techniques.when_to_use: Login forms or POST-based inputs

techniques.name: SQLMap OS Shell
techniques.purpose: Get OS command execution via SQLi
techniques.when_to_use: When SQLi exists and DB user has FILE privilege

techniques.name: LFI Basic Test
techniques.purpose: Read local files via path traversal
techniques.when_to_use: When a file parameter exists in URL

techniques.name: LFI via PHP Filter (Source Read)
techniques.purpose: Read PHP source code via base64 filter
techniques.when_to_use: When LFI exists and target runs PHP

techniques.name: LFI Log Poisoning (Apache)
techniques.purpose: Turn LFI into RCE via log injection
techniques.when_to_use: When LFI can read /var/log/apache2/access.log

techniques.name: File Upload Bypass (Magic Bytes)
techniques.purpose: Bypass file type checks with magic bytes
techniques.when_to_use: When upload only allows images

techniques.name: Command Injection Test
techniques.purpose: Execute OS commands via web input
techniques.when_to_use: When user input is passed to OS commands

techniques.name: XSS Cookie Steal
techniques.purpose: Steal session cookies via XSS
techniques.when_to_use: When reflected/stored XSS exists

techniques.name: FFUF Parameter Fuzzing
techniques.purpose: Discover hidden GET parameters
techniques.when_to_use: When fuzzing web app parameters

techniques.name: SSRF Internal Probe
techniques.purpose: Access internal services via SSRF
techniques.when_to_use: When app fetches URLs based on user input

techniques.name: XXE File Read
techniques.purpose: Read local files via XML External Entity
techniques.when_to_use: When app parses XML input
techniques.command: curl -X POST 'http://{TARGET_IP}/xml' -d '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE root [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><root>&xxe;</root>'

techniques.name: IDOR Test
techniques.purpose: Access other users' data by changing IDs
techniques.when_to_use: When object references are in URL/body

techniques.name: JWT None Algorithm Attack
techniques.purpose: Bypass JWT signature verification
techniques.when_to_use: When app uses JWT and doesn't validate alg
